en.help.text:
CSV Plotter / Multi-Subplot CSV Viewer

Files & folders:
- Choose Folder: set the root folder for CSV logs.
- Choose CSV File: load a specific CSV file (turns OFF Auto-load newest).
- History menu: Prev/Next and quick-open recent files.
- History -> Clear history: clears the recent files list.

Auto loading:
- Auto-load newest CSV: periodically finds/loads the newest CSV under the folder tree.
- Auto-reload selected CSV: reloads the currently loaded CSV when the file changes.

Subplots & selection:
- Add Subplot: adds a selector + plot panel.
- Close (per subplot): removes that subplot selector and its plot.
- Multi-select: Ctrl-click toggles; Shift-click selects a range.
- Right-click on a plotted line: removes that signal from the subplot selection and replots.
- Left-click on a plotted line: highlights the line and its legend entry.

Time-series overlays (per subplot):
- Overlay files: add multiple CSV files and plot them together.
- Overlay X: choose Aligned timestamps vs Independent (t=0 per file).
- Per-file shifts: set X shift (sec) and Y shift for the selected overlay file.

Plots & tools:
- Mode (per subplot): Time series + special analysis views (MS-1353 / AF-10047).
- Toolbar: Zoom, Pan, Home/Back/Forward.
- X-range sync: zoom/pan syncs across subplots (where supported by the mode).
- Manual Y limits (per subplot): enable and set Min/Max to lock y-scale.
- Time window selection: drag on the plot (when Zoom/Pan is OFF) to select a segment;
  stats and histogram use only that segment. Use Clear window to reset.

Stats & histogram:
- Show table: computed metrics for selected signals.
- Show histogram: value distribution for selected signals (uses current time window if set).

Resizable UI:
- Drag the sashes to resize left/right, controls vs selectors, subplot panels, and plot vs histogram/table areas.

Layout:
- Layout -> Save/Load layout: store/restore selections and per-subplot settings.
- Layout -> Clear layout: reset UI and delete layout.json.
- Settings -> Auto-save layout (layout.json): auto-saves to layout.json (toggleable).
